dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: Please abide by the rules of the manor, guest.

dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: It is likely the name of a guest who was supposed to attend the ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: Perhaps, to the person wishing for his presence, he is a very important guest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the rules of the manor...

dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: Oh? Would you like me to repeat myself?

dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: The ritual will begin when <color=#00E1FFFF>the clock strikes eight times</color>. Please make your way to the chapel right away when you hear it.

dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: Until then, you may look around the main hall, but the other rooms are not open to guests.

dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: Ah... Myshkin, Myshkin... No, it can't be. How could you already be...?

dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: I... my Myshkin... How could I forget that he was once here? I forgot... I forgot that he was dragged into this ritual too...

dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: I've waited here... for so, so long...

dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: *Sob*... To think I'd completely forget... forget that he was already...

dialogues.speaker: Aglaia
dialogues.text: This must be... my punishment. If only I'd had the courage to step outside the mansion, instead of trying to make him come looking for me... *sob*...
